questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition in the supply of childcare services.

Do Imagine Education and Eden Academy operated childcare centres compete closely in the supply of childcare services? As part of your response, describe whether there are certain areas where the removal of Eden Academy as an alternative to an Imagine Education site would impact competition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Imagine Education and/or Eden Academy.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.

questions.section: Questions for operators of childcare centres
questions.text: Identify the childcare centres you operate that compete for enrolments with an Imagine Education and/or Eden Academy childcare centre, including its location.
